description: Exactly one alternative holds: every cardinal-sized subset has a point with a cardinal-sized colour-one neighbourhood, or one such subset has only smaller neighbourhoods.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.UncountablePartition.neighborhood_dichotomy.{u} {α : Type u}
  (c : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.UncountablePartition.PairColoring α) (κ : Cardinal.{u}) :
  ((∀ (X : Set α),
        Cardinal.mk ↑X = κ →
          ∃ x ∈ X, Cardinal.mk ↑(Lemmatheca.SetTheory.UncountablePartition.oneNeighbors c x ∩ X) = κ) ∨
      ∃ X,
        Cardinal.mk ↑X = κ ∧
          ∀ x ∈ X, Cardinal.mk ↑(Lemmatheca.SetTheory.UncountablePartition.oneNeighbors c x ∩ X) < κ) ∧
    ¬((∀ (X : Set α),
          Cardinal.mk ↑X = κ →
            ∃ x ∈ X, Cardinal.mk ↑(Lemmatheca.SetTheory.UncountablePartition.oneNeighbors c x ∩ X) = κ) ∧
        ∃ X,
          Cardinal.mk ↑X = κ ∧
            ∀ x ∈ X, Cardinal.mk ↑(Lemmatheca.SetTheory.UncountablePartition.oneNeighbors c x ∩ X) < κ)
